entries.oak_welcome_riley: Ah, Riley! Fresh off the Pallet Channel ferry and already ready to chase the Kanto League!
entries.oak_welcome_tasha: Welcome to Pallet Town, Tasha! I heard your flight touched down early this morning.
entries.oak_welcome_custom: Welcome, {player_name}! Both Pokémon (PKDX) and Moemon (MDX) await your discovery across Kanto.
entries.brock_challenge: I'm Brock, Pewter City's Gym Leader! My rock-hard willpower is evident even in my Pokémon—let's battle!
entries.brock_victory: I took you for granted! Take this Boulder Badge as proof of your victory!
